summary: Added a repository-managed safe lockfile generation command and taught the supply-chain regression gate to require it.

details: Added supply-chain:lockfile script using npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts.
Fails if supply-chain:lockfile does not generate only the lockfile and ignore lifecycle scripts.
Requires docs/security/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md to mention supply-chain:lockfile as evidence.
Documented npm run supply-chain:lockfile as the official first-lockfile generation command.
Updated regression gates, checklist and open hardening items.

notes: No package-lock.json was generated in this environment because network-backed npm install is not available here.
This change prepares the repository for a reproducible lockfile/audit handoff once npm can resolve dependencies.
